entities.name: TAR syndrome
observations: Thrombocytopenia-absent radius syndrome features bilateral radial aplasia with thumbs generally present; thrombocytopenia can cause serious bleeding, especially in infancy.

entities.name: TAR bleeding risk
observations: TAR-associated thrombocytopenia creates clinically important hemorrhage risk in infancy.

entities.name: PMID:25443176
observations: 2015 study of 167 patients with stable chronic heart failure; excluded acute coronary syndrome, recent revascularization, mitral stenosis, hemodialysis, and clinically significant right-sided heart failure.

entities.name: Independent hs-cTnT associations
observations: In stable chronic heart failure, multivariable analysis found LVEDP positively associated with hs-cTnT (adjusted coefficient 0.014, 95% CI 0.0003–0.029; P=0.046) and LVEF inversely associated (−0.011, 95% CI −0.018 to −0.003; P=0.004). Abstract-reported; units and further model details unavailable.
